subject: Unexpected mid-cycle token jump after model rollout - request for credit
messages:
From: Elena Martinez <elena@skylark-commerce.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Sudden mid-month usage spike / invoice attached

Hi Aditya,

We just received the November invoice and there is a ~48% jump compared to our usual consumption. I attached the CSV export from your billing portal (skylark_invoice_202611-raw.csv). We didn’t change any of our flows — the only thing that changed on our side was a quick experiment toggling the model selector to your recommended endpoint last week.

Can you help explain what generated this big jump? We need a clear breakdown and — if this is on Redwood — a provisional credit while this is resolved. We’re running through our finance close and this unexpected line item will block payment.

Thanks,
Elena
Ops Lead | Skylark Commerce

Attachment: skylark_invoice_202611-raw.csv (text/csv, 128KB)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@skylark-commerce.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:44:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Sudden mid-month usage spike / invoice attached

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the heads up and the CSV. I’m sorry for the disruption in your close. I’m looping in Alex from Billing and Lauren from CS so we can triage quickly.

Quick asks while we look:
- Can you attach a representative API call (header + payload) if you have one around Nov 3–5?
- Did your engineering team see any automated jobs or backfills run in that window?

We’ll do a provisional review and come back within 48h with a proposed credit or reconciliation.

—Aditya
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@skylark-commerce.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:08:20 -0800
Subject: Re: Sudden mid-month usage spike / invoice attached

Elena —

I pulled a usage snapshot for Skylark from 2026-11-01 through 2026-11-09 and compared token-level counts and model variants. Two things stand out:

1) On 2026-11-03 at ~22:05 UTC, we see a sustained switch in traffic from model rwd-13b (tokenizer v1) -> rwd-13b-tokenv2 (tokenizer v2). The switch corresponds to a deployment flag in our routing layer that rolled forward a tokenization update for that model.

2) The v2 tokenizer emits roughly 1.35x tokens for the same payload patterns Skylark uses (long system prompts + multi-turn chat where you pass longer user histories). That multiplier aligns with the ~48% jump on the invoice.

I’ve attached: usage_snapshot_20261103-20261109.json (trimmed) and a short CSV of the per-day delta.

Preliminary assessment: this looks like a product-side tokenizer/variant change that increased your measured token count mid-cycle. We are treating this as a redwood-side configuration change (not an action taken by Skylark) since routing rules rolled a model variant with a different tokenization without opt-in.

Next steps we propose:
- Issue a provisional credit equal to the token-delta * your unit rate for the billing period (pending final validation).
- Re-issue a corrected invoice that shows pre-credit, credit line, and VAT recalculation as needed.
- Engineering will validate the exact delta and confirm there’s no double-counting from retries.

Lauren / Billing Ops / Legal — please chime in if I missed anything.

Thanks,
Alex
Billing Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachment: usage_snapshot_20261103-20261109.json (application/json, 48KB)
From: Elena Martinez <elena@skylark-commerce.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 07:22:05 -0800
Subject: Re: Sudden mid-month usage spike / invoice attached

Alex —

Thanks for the quick analysis. That matches what our devs suspected when we compared token counts locally. We appreciate Redwood treating this as a platform-side change. Two additional items:

1) VAT: Skylark is billed centrally in the US but the legal entity that pays invoices in November is our EU subsidiary (Skylark GmbH). How will we get a corrected invoice with EU VAT (reverse-charge or VAT number) applied correctly? We need the invoice for our VAT reclaim.

2) Timing for cashflow: We need the provisional credit reflected in a revised invoice by EOD Monday 11/16 so our AP team can process payment. Otherwise we’ll need to park payment (and escalate) due to audit controls.

I attached the PO (SKL-PO-8897) for reference.

—Elena

Attachment: purchase_order_SKL-PO-8897.pdf (application/pdf, 62KB)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@skylark-commerce.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:34 -0800
Subject: Re: Sudden mid-month usage spike / invoice attached

Hi Elena —

Good news: we’ve agreed internally on a provisional remediation. Summary below so you can share with AP:

- Provisional credit: Redwood will apply a credit equal to the token-delta (we show ~1.35x multiplier from Nov 3–9) multiplied by Skylark’s active per-token rate on the account. The provisional credit appears as "Platform token adjustment (provisional)" on the revised invoice.
- VAT handling: Billing will re-issue the invoice in Skylark GmbH’s name and include the VAT line as reverse-charge where applicable. Please confirm the VAT ID for the paying entity so we can populate the invoice correctly.
- Timeline: Revised invoice with provisional credit and VAT breakdown will be sent by end of day 2026-11-16. Final reconciliation will follow after engineering confirms final token delta (estimated by 11/20).

Next step from your side: reply with the paying entity name and EU VAT number to populate the invoice. Once we have that we’ll finalize the reissue and send a formal credit note.

I’ll keep you posted. Thanks for the patience—sorry again for the disruption to your close.

—Aditya
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@skylark-commerce.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sudden mid-month usage spike / invoice attached

Elena / Aditya —

Final confirmation from Billing Ops / Engineering: we confirmed no retry-related double-counting; the delta is attributable solely to tokenizer v2 rollout. We will: 

1) Apply a provisional credit equal to 100% of the usage delta for Nov 3–9 (line item will read: "Retroactive tokenizer adjustment — credit").
2) Re-issue the November invoice to Skylark GmbH with the credit and VAT reversed-charge details populated (please confirm VAT ID by reply).
3) Issue a formal credit note and HubSpot ticket update (HubSpot ID: HS-87294).

Expected timing: corrected invoice and credit note issued by 2026-11-16 23:59 PST. Please treat this provisional credit as applied for AP purposes; we will notify if any minor adjustments are needed after final reconciliation on 11/20.

If you’d like a short call to confirm details I can make time tomorrow morning.

Thanks,
Alex
Billing Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachment: (none)
